mcqs.question: What was the value of India’s defence exports in 2025–26?
mcqs.explanation: India’s defence exports reached a record ₹38,424 crore in 2025–26, registering a 62.66% increase. ₹21,071 crore was the contribution of DPSUs, while ₹17,353 crore came from private companies; ₹35,000 crore was the DPEPP 2020 target for 2025.
